scheme.name: Jadrolinija's state ferry lines, goods vehicles

dataset.method: Jadrolinija's price lists for 2026, line by line (state ferry lines, the fares the Agency for Coastal Line Traffic approves): goods vehicles and trailers by load capacity (nosivost): up to 3 t, 3.01-4 t and 4.01-5 t a fare each, from 5.01 t a fare per tonne of it, for each vehicle on its own, but a tractor with semi-trailer per tonne of the semi-trailer's (give truck.capacity_kg; without it the fare isn't priced). Off-season and season prices by the season's days in each price list (or one price for the year). The prices include port dues and VAT; VAT is taken out at Croatia's standard 25% (the rate Jadrolinija's price lists named until 2024), the port dues stay in. Island residents' and public services' prices aren't used. The ports are OpenStreetMap's ferry terminals (else the place), priced where a line goes out on OpenStreetMap's car ferry line from them; lines that share a ferry line or a harbour mouth are one system, priced from the first port passed to the last. PREMUDA–IST: no car ferry line between them in OpenStreetMap, not priced.
